title: Chanka–Inca War
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Chanka–Inca War", at revision 1379843429, opens: "The Inca-Chanka war was a semi-legendary, mytho-historical, potentially mythical, military conflict fought between Cusco and the Chanka chiefdom, several generations prior to the arrival of Europeans. It is the final conflict between these two people." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5643516, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "15th-century semi-legendary war". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
